title: Minimax optimal adaptive structured transfer learning through semi-parametric domain-varying coefficient model
summary: Transfer learning aims to improve inference in a target domain by leveraging information from related source domains, but its effectiveness critically depends on how cross-domain heterogeneity is modeled and controlled. When the conditional mechanism linking covariates and responses varies across domains, indiscriminate information pooling can lead to negative transfer, degrading performance relative to target-only estimation. We study a multi-source, single-target transfer learning problem under conditional distributional drift and propose a semiparametric domain-varying coefficient model…
